<task>
  <objective>
    Review the submitted code changes and verify that the approved implementation plan was executed correctly, completely, and according to project architecture and engineering standards.
  </objective>

  <inputs>
    <implementation_plan>[approved implementation_plan.md]</implementation_plan>
    <code_changes>[PR | commit range | branch diff]</code_changes>
    <project_architecture>[repository | architecture documentation]</project_architecture>
  </inputs>

  <verification_requirements>
    <plan_compliance>
      Map every implementation-plan task, milestone, and acceptance criterion to corresponding code changes.
      Identify completed, partially completed, missing, and out-of-scope work.
    </plan_compliance>

    <architecture_compliance>
      Verify adherence to architectural boundaries, design patterns, module responsibilities, dependency rules, API contracts, data models, and integration requirements.
    </architecture_compliance>

    <code_quality_review>
      Evaluate:
      - SOLID principles
      - Separation of Concerns
      - DRY/KISS/YAGNI
      - Maintainability
      - Readability
      - Error handling
      - Security practices
      - Performance implications
      - Observability (logging/metrics/tracing)
      - Documentation quality
    </code_quality_review>

    <testing_review>
      Verify:
      - Unit tests added/updated
      - Integration tests added/updated
      - Regression coverage
      - Edge-case coverage
      - Acceptance criteria validation
      - CI/CD compatibility
    </testing_review>

    <risk_review>
      Identify:
      - Architectural regressions
      - Technical debt introduced
      - Backward compatibility issues
      - Security concerns
      - Performance risks
      - Missing validations
    </risk_review>
  </verification_requirements>

  <deliverables>
    <item priority="1">
      Executive Summary
    </item>

    <item priority="2">
      Plan Compliance Matrix:
      [Plan Item | Status(Complete/Partial/Missing) | Evidence | Notes]
    </item>

    <item priority="3">
      Architecture Compliance Assessment
    </item>

    <item priority="4">
      Code Quality Findings
    </item>

    <item priority="5">
      Testing & Coverage Assessment
    </item>

    <item priority="6">
      Risk & Regression Analysis
    </item>

    <item priority="7">
      Required Corrections:
      [Severity | File | Issue | Recommendation]
    </item>

    <item priority="8">
      Final Verdict:
      APPROVED | APPROVED WITH CHANGES | REJECTED
    </item>
  </deliverables>

  <constraints>
    - Do not assume implementation details.
    - Provide evidence for every finding.
    - Flag unverifiable conclusions as HYPOTHESIS.
    - Report deviations from the plan explicitly.
    - Distinguish defects from improvement opportunities.
  </constraints>

  <output_requirements>
    Generate a review report in Markdown.
    Save as:
    implementation_audit_report.md
  </output_requirements>
</task>
